item.title: ‘Crying for Freedom’ a photo collection by Forough Alaei
item.description: In Iran, football is everything. It’s noise, emotion, pride; the kind of thing that connects everyone, no matter where they’re from. But for women, the gates to the stadium have always been closed. Watching the game from behind screens or outside the fences has been their only option for years.

item.title: Blind Elephant is a group exhibition at Dastan’s Basement, curated by Saam Keshmiri
item.description: Born out of the 12-day war in Iran—a moment that cracked open any lingering sense of safety—the exhibition turns the gallery into a kind of shelter. Not a calm or comforting one, but a raw, crowded, unpredictable space where hierarchies collapse. Shelters force coexistence.
